_comment: Single place for every outbound link AERIS Music uses. A link that is empty is omitted from the video descriptions, so the block degrades cleanly until K fills the affiliate id in.
_shopee_links_comment: Per-surface s.shopee.co.th links minted in the affiliate dashboard with a sub_id. A th.shp.ee short link strips sub_id, so only these give per-surface attribution. Keys: youtube, tiktok, facebook. Empty falls back to shopee_affiliate.
